output.title: New Prometheus metrics may reach monitored cert-manager
output.content: This environment has Prometheus ServiceMonitor enabled (`prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled` and `prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort` configured), indicating active metric collection from cert-manager. The v1.18.0 upgrade adds certificate issuance and expiration timestamp metrics that will be emitted alongside existing metrics. Verify whether Prometheus is actively scraping these endpoints and check if any downstream monitoring, alerting, or dashboards depend on the specific set of available metrics.
